_about: Chapter 2 (hold the gate): the plaza in front of the MVIDIA headquarters.
One entry per asset. id = art/blender/<id>.py = web/assets/models/<id>.glb = the prop name used in levels.
class sets the triangle limit: small_prop 1500, large_prop 6000, module 3000, landmark 20000. maxTriangles (optional) lowers it.
size is [width X, height Y, depth Z] in metres, in game axes; the built model must match it within 10 %.
status: planned = not made yet (tools skip it), wip = being made (checked when its GLB exists), ready = approved; the game loads a model only when it is ready.
pivot (optional): "custom" when the origin is on the ground but not under the middle of the model (e.g. a lamp post with a long arm).
Owned by the chapter 2 team member.
